zh: AI 指针群升级为 Figma 风格多工具协同画布：指针根据操作语义自动切换箭头（arrow）、十字框选（crosshair）、文本输入（ibeam）与钢笔矢量（pen）形态，支持沿着元素边缘落下锚点与闪烁排版光标校对。
新增像素标尺与相邻元素间距红线：绘制期间在画布顶边与左边显示 16px 标尺及活动选区投影，实时测量真实 DOM 兄弟节点之间的像素间距并绘制对齐参考线；同步增强宽选框的坐标尺寸角标。
新增可选 Web Audio 协同音效开关：顶栏提供「音效」按钮（默认静音并持久化偏好），开启后按指针横向位置生成立体声敲击、落点音阶共鸣与完成和弦。
修复 AI 指针点选元素分支遗留的未定义函数调用隐患，确保指针全程流畅稳定运行。
en: Upgraded the AI cursor swarm to a Figma-style multi-tool canvas: cursors switch dynamically between arrow, crosshair marquee, I-beam text inspection, and vector pen nibs with anchor-point drafting and blinking caret passes.
Added Figma-inspired top/left 16px pixel rulers with active selection bands, live sibling DOM spacing redlines, alignment hairlines, and coordinate/dimension badges on marquee selections.
Added an optional Web Audio collaboration sound toggle in the top bar (muted by default, saved across sessions) with stereo-panned clicks, pentatonic snap chimes, and a soft completion chord.
Fixed a lingering undefined helper call in the touch-highlight path so cursor actions execute cleanly without runtime errors.
